Thanks again for the support during our pilot — the team has been impressed with the latency improvements and the quick onboarding. We have about 18 days left on the timeboxed pilot but our usage profile is spikier than expected (bursty ingestion tests mid-week).

Hi Samantha —

Appreciate the context and the usage CSV; this is helpful. Short answer: we can do either extension or convert to a drawdown bucket. For conversions we usually:
- size the bucket to the expected remaining token equivalent (we'll propose two sizing options: conservative and optimistic)
- offer a small operational discount on that bucket for pilots (we typically offer 10–25% depending on commitment and runway)
- guarantee burst capacity for short windows (we'll hold headroom in Dedicated pool or guarantee fallbacks to a slightly higher-latency host if Dedicated burst isn't available)

I'll run the numbers with finance/solutions and get back with a proposal that shows: bucket size, suggested discount, what model variants are included (gpt-redwood-*-base vs quantized variants), and a two-week extension alternative so procurement can choose. Can you confirm whether your security/compliance team needs a separate doc for burst fallback?

Best,
Olga Petrov
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Hi Samantha —

Thanks for your patience while we modeled options. Attached is a short proposal (RW-Bridgeway-ShortPilot-Proposal-20260616.pdf) and a CSV with the bucket sizing math. Summary below so procurement has a one-line option: 

Option A — Drawdown bucket (recommended):
- Bucket size (conservative): equivalent to remaining 18 days = 1.1M token units
- Bucket size (optimistic): 1.5M token units (covers burst scenario)
- Pilot bucket discount: 20% off our standard pay-as-you-go rate for the bucket if committed to using within 45 days
- Models included: gpt-redwood-4o (standard) + quantized 4o-q for non-critical workloads; burst guarantee up to 300% of baseline for short windows (subject to transient throttling); no additional license required
- Billing: one invoice for the bucket; unused tokens expire after 45 days

Option B — 2-week timeboxed extension:
- Price: standard timebox daily rate pro-rated for 14 days (no discount)
- Concession: 15% pilot concession if they commit to a Dedicated evaluation within 60 days

We recommend Option A because it matches procurement preferences and reduces administrative effort. If you want, we can split the bucket into 60/40 (conservative/optimistic) and provide a lower blended discount (15%) for the split approach.

Next steps: please confirm which option you want by Wed 2026-06-23 so we can issue an amendment/PO-friendly invoice. If procurement needs an SSO or separate burst-fallback doc for security, we can attach the technical note.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 20-minute call if that helps.
